description: Elemental composition of ribo-/deoxyribonucleotide monophosphates. 'free' is the hydrated monophosphate as it exists outside a chain (e.g. AMP); 'polymer' is the dehydrated in-chain residue (free minus one H2O, released per phosphodiester bond formed with the next nucleotide). The model samples polymerized RNA/DNA (see metabolism_low_dim/model.py::sample_nucleic_acid_from_gc), so it uses 'polymer'. Molecular weights in each note use the same atomic masses as metabolism_low_dim/constants.py::ATOMIC_MASS.

A.note: free = adenosine 5'-monophosphate (AMP), MW 347.22; polymer = free minus H2O, MW 329.21

C.note: free = cytidine 5'-monophosphate (CMP), MW 323.20; polymer = free minus H2O, MW 305.18

G.note: free = guanosine 5'-monophosphate (GMP), MW 363.22; polymer = free minus H2O, MW 345.21

U.note: free = uridine 5'-monophosphate (UMP), MW 324.18; polymer = free minus H2O, MW 306.17

A.note: free = 2'-deoxyadenosine 5'-monophosphate (dAMP), MW 331.22; polymer = free minus H2O, MW 313.21

C.note: free = 2'-deoxycytidine 5'-monophosphate (dCMP), MW 307.20; polymer = free minus H2O, MW 289.18

G.note: free = 2'-deoxyguanosine 5'-monophosphate (dGMP), MW 347.22; polymer = free minus H2O, MW 329.21

T.note: free = thymidine 5'-monophosphate (dTMP), MW 322.21; polymer = free minus H2O, MW 304.20
